name: can-i-remove-this
title_zh: 先查依赖能不能删再动手的瘦身审计员
tagline_zh: 面对 package.json 里每个依赖，它逐条判断：能整个删、能换原生 API、还是该渐进替换。不靠猜。
tagline_en: Each dependency gets a verdict: remove, swap for native API, or progressively replace—backed by Baseline data.
desc_en: Audit browser-delivered JavaScript dependencies and decide whether they can be removed, partially replaced, or progressively replaced with Baseline web platform features. Use when reviewing package.json dependencies, reducing frontend bundle size, replacing libraries with native APIs, or asking whether a dependency is still needed.
why_zh: 它不只看体积，而是对照 Baseline 平台特性，给出删、换、渐进三条路径，让依赖瘦身有据可依。
why_en: It maps every dependency to Baseline platform features, offering three clear paths—delete, replace, or phase out—so bundle.
limit_zh: 只审计浏览器端 JS 依赖，不覆盖 Node.js 包；需要联网查 Baseline 数据；产物是判断和建议。
limit_en: Audits browser-side JS deps only; no Node.js. Needs internet for Baseline data. Outputs verdicts & advice, no auto code changes.
title_en: Dependency removal auditor for browser JS bundles
